_note: Source of truth for onboarding speech. Clips are generated from this by agent/scripts/generate_onboarding_audio.py into assets/onboarding/<lang>/<id>.mp3. Yoruba, Hausa and Igbo lines NEED NATIVE-SPEAKER REVIEW.

welcome.en: Welcome to SafeStep. Tap anywhere on the screen to start.
welcome.pcm: Welcome to SafeStep. Touch anywhere for the screen make we start.
welcome.yo: Ẹ kú àbọ̀ sí SafeStep. Tẹ ibikíbi lórí ojú fóònù láti bẹ̀rẹ̀.
welcome.ha: Barka da zuwa SafeStep. Taɓa ko'ina a allon don farawa.
welcome.ig: Nnọọ na SafeStep. Pịa ebe ọ bụla na ihuenyo ka ịmalite.

mic_request.en: SafeStep needs your microphone so you can talk to it. Your phone will now ask for permission. The allow button is usually at the bottom.
mic_request.pcm: SafeStep need your microphone make you fit talk to am. Your phone go ask you now. The allow button dey for down.

mic_denied.en: SafeStep cannot work without the microphone. Tap anywhere to try again.
mic_denied.pcm: SafeStep no fit work without microphone. Touch anywhere make we try again.

choose_language.en: Which language do you want? Say English, Pidgin, Yoruba, Hausa, or Igbo. Or tap: one tap for English, two for Pidgin, three for Yoruba, four for Hausa, five for Igbo.
choose_language.pcm: Which language you want? Talk am now.
choose_language.yo: Èdè wo lẹ fẹ́? Ẹ sọ ọ́ báyìí.
choose_language.ha: Wane harshe kake so? Faɗa yanzu.
choose_language.ig: Kedu asụsụ ị chọrọ? Kwuo ya ugbu a.

language_not_heard.en: Sorry, I did not catch that.
language_not_heard.pcm: Sorry, I no hear am well.

language_confirmed.en: English. Tap twice quickly to change, or wait.
language_confirmed.pcm: Pidgin. Touch two times quick quick if you wan change am, or just wait.
language_confirmed.yo: Yorùbá. Tẹ ẹ̀ẹ̀mejì kíákíá láti yí i padà, tàbí kí ẹ dúró.
language_confirmed.ha: Hausa. Taɓa sau biyu da sauri don canzawa, ko ka jira.
language_confirmed.ig: Igbo. Pịa ugboro abụọ ngwa ngwa ka ịgbanwee ya, ma ọ bụ chere.

camera_location.en: SafeStep uses the camera to spot dangers like open gutters, and your location to guide you. Your phone will now ask for both.
camera_location.pcm: SafeStep dey use camera take see danger like open gutter, and your location take show you road. Your phone go ask you for the two now.
camera_location.yo: SafeStep ń lo kámẹ́rà láti rí ewu bí kòtò tó ṣí sílẹ̀, àti ibi tí ẹ wà láti tọ́ yín sọ́nà. Fóònù yín yóò béèrè fún méjèèjì báyìí.
camera_location.ha: SafeStep na amfani da kyamara don ganin haɗari kamar buɗaɗɗen magudanar ruwa, da wurinka don jagorantarka. Wayarka za ta nemi duka biyun yanzu.
camera_location.ig: SafeStep na-eji igwefoto ahụ ihe egwu dịka olulu mmiri meghere emeghe, na ebe ị nọ iji duzie gị. Ekwentị gị ga-ajụ maka ha abụọ ugbu a.

permissions_denied.en: Without the camera I cannot warn you about dangers. You can allow it later in settings.
permissions_denied.pcm: If camera no dey, I no fit warn you about danger. You fit allow am later for settings.
permissions_denied.yo: Láìsí kámẹ́rà, mi ò lè kìlọ̀ fún yín nípa ewu. Ẹ lè gbà á láàyè lẹ́yìn náà nínú ètò.
permissions_denied.ha: Ba tare da kyamara ba, ba zan iya gargade ka game da haɗari ba. Za ka iya ba da izini daga baya a saituna.
permissions_denied.ig: Na-enweghị igwefoto, enweghị m ike ịdọ gị aka ná ntị maka ihe egwu. Ị nwere ike ikwe ya ma emechaa na ntọala.

tips_offer.en: Tap once to hear some tips, or wait to skip.
tips_offer.pcm: Touch one time if you wan hear small advice, or just wait.
tips_offer.yo: Tẹ ẹ̀ẹ̀kan láti gbọ́ àwọn ìmọ̀ràn, tàbí kí ẹ dúró láti fò ó.
tips_offer.ha: Taɓa sau ɗaya don jin wasu shawarwari, ko ka jira don tsallakewa.
tips_offer.ig: Pịa otu ugboro ka ịnụ ndụmọdụ, ma ọ bụ chere ka ịgafe.

tips.en: Hold the phone at chest height with the back camera facing forward. Just speak to talk to me. Double tap anywhere to mute or unmute the microphone. You can say: take me to a place, warnings only, or stop warning me.
tips.pcm: Hold the phone for your chest, make the back camera face front. Just talk, I go hear you. Touch two times to off or on the microphone. You fit talk: carry me go one place, na only warning I want, or stop to dey warn me.
tips.yo: Ẹ di fóònù mú ní ìbámu àyà yín, kí kámẹ́rà ẹ̀yìn kọjú sí iwájú. Ẹ kàn sọ̀rọ̀ láti bá mi sọ̀rọ̀. Ẹ tẹ ẹ̀ẹ̀mejì láti pa tàbí tan gbohùngbohùn.
tips.ha: Riƙe wayar a tsayin ƙirjinka, kyamarar baya tana fuskantar gaba. Kawai yi magana don magana da ni. Taɓa sau biyu don kashe ko kunna makirufo.
tips.ig: Jide ekwentị n'ogo obi gị, ka igwefoto azụ chee ihu. Naanị kwuo okwu ka gị na m kparịta. Pịa ugboro abụọ iji gbanyụọ ma ọ bụ gbanwuo igwe okwu.
